title: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings

suppliers.sup:70110: Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

messages.from_name: Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG
messages.subject: Quote from Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
messages.body:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. For many years, our family foundry has taken great pride in supplying your respected company with high-quality castings from our region, and we value our long standing relationship very much.

Our team has prepared our offer carefully. We can offer you a price of €138.55 per unit, valid from 1 November 2026. This Angebot remains valid for 30 days.

To remain transparent about our situation, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 30 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 24 % of our cost. We trust that you understand the necessity of these figures for our ongoing operation and quality standards.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

messages.subject: HN 50-200 volute casings (part:310010) - our proposal for 2027
messages.body:
Dear Mr Brandlhuber,

Thank you for your offer and for the partnership you showed us in 2022, which we value.

Our should-cost estimate for part:310010 is EUR 132.64 per unit (cost:310010), below your price.
The forecast for part:310010 increased by 10.1% (fc:310010@2026-09); please reflect this additional business in your price.
PPI-D351 fell from 140.5 (idx:PPI-D351@2025-11) to 123.7 (idx:PPI-D351@2026-04), a change of -11.96%.

We attach three packages for 8150 pieces per year over 12 months. One pays your invoices within 14 days, which supports your cash flow as you asked on 2 September. Which package suits you best, and is there a cheaper casting variant we should consider?

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke Purchasing

messages.from_name: Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG
messages.subject: Re: HN 50-200 volute casings (part:310010) - our proposal for 2027
messages.body:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

Our price is €133.70 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 14 days net, valid from 1 January 2027. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

We value our long-standing partnership and are pleased to build upon your second package, accepting the 14-day payment terms. We checked the index change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We also checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. Furthermore, we checked the should cost data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We did not know that - a fair point.

LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 30 % of our cost. That remains. PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 24 % of our cost. That remains. Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal. 

Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net. A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to? Our technical team will reach out to you directly to explore whether a more economical casting variant is feasible for your application.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

Foundry Engineer: We build strictly according to your drawing and do not propose any design changes.

messages.subject: HN 50-200 volute casings – updated packages
messages.body:
Dear Mr Brandlhuber,

Thank you for moving towards us and for accepting the 14-day payment terms. We value your family foundry as a long-term partner and want a price that keeps both sides healthy.

Your latest scorecard records on-time delivery of 85.2% (sc:70110@2026Q3).

We attach two packages for 8150 pieces per year over 12 months. The first keeps your preferred 14-day payment, which supports your cash flow. The second gives you a later start date in exchange for standard payment terms.

Could you also tell us the earliest lead time you can confirm for call-offs from January, and what steps you plan to raise delivery reliability?

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke Purchasing

Our production team will reach out to you directly to discuss lead times and our steps to ensure delivery reliability. It is always a pleasure working alongside your team, and we look forward to continuing our shared history.

messages.subject: HN 50-200 volute casings - revised package from 1 January 2027
messages.body:
Dear Mr Brandlhuber,

Thank you for your revised offer and for keeping the 14-day payment terms. We are glad to build on our shared history with your family foundry.

Your previous scorecard records 626 ppm (sc:70110@2026Q2).

The attached package keeps your preferred structure: 8150 pieces per year, 12 months, effective 1 January 2027, payment within 14 days. Payment within 14 days supports your cash flow, as you asked on 2 September. We have moved towards you again and hope we can close on this basis.

We look forward to your production team's lead-time confirmation. Could you also tell us which steps would bring the ppm back towards that earlier quarter's level?

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke Purchasing

messages.from_name: Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG
messages.subject: Re: HN 50-200 volute casings - revised package from 1 January 2027
messages.body:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We value our shared history and are pleased to build on your package with 14-day payment terms. The quality record you cited was already addressed and factored into our previous offers. To bring us closer to a conclusion, we propose a revised price of €130.80 per unit. 

For this updated framework, our offer stands at a price of €130.80 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, valid from 1 January 2027. Additionally, our Lieferzeit is 42 days. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

It is always a pleasure working together, and we look forward to continuing our tradition of shared success with Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

messages.body:
Dear Mr Brandlhuber,

Thank you for your revised offer and for the 8D report on part:310010. We appreciate the containment and corrective actions you have started.

Our quality notifications qn:20004728, qn:20004837, qn:20004853, qn:20004877, qn:20004934, qn:20004978, qn:20004995 record defective deliveries of part:310010.

The attached package keeps your preferred structure: 8150 pieces per year, 12 months, effective 1 January 2027, payment within 14 days, which supports your cash flow. We have moved towards you again.

We look forward to your first D4 root-cause findings.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke Purchasing

messages.from_name: Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG
messages.subject: Re: HN 50-200 volute casings (part:310010) - revised package for 2027
messages.body:
Guten Tag,

We received a lot of material; we looked at what bears on this part, and we have already taken that quality record data into account. The quality notifications you mentioned were already addressed in our previous discussions and factored into our current pricing. We appreciate your continued partnership and the package structure. Over the years, our foundry has always valued the strong relationship between our companies in this region, and we take great pride in the dedication of our skilled people and the castings we deliver. 

In response to your question, our offer of €130.80 represents our final position for these terms. Which figures is that based on? Please send us the data. Our margin and our limits stay internal, and our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal. 

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. Our Angebot stands at a price of €130.80 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, valid from 1 January 2027. This offer is valid for 7 days.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

Quality Manager: We take the complaints seriously; our 8D report is attached.
